scope: Local implementation and static/synthetic noninterference checks only; no BCSS qualification replay.

stages.P2: local static and synthetic checks passed; independent review pending
stages.P3: A/B/C not authorized and not executed

build_identity.commit_binding: Introducing commit binds these file hashes; a separately frozen execution manifest must record the full observer-build commit and runtime before any replay.

static_review.argument_review: Hook arguments are existing names, attributes and constants; no eager function calls/comprehensions, no calls to planner/guard/RNG for logging.

fixtures: Actual deterministic mask executor on a small synthetic labelled image, observer off/hash_only/full_capture: exact result, plan/audit/selected-raster equality and unchanged input/global RNG states.
Actual ranged-area underfill path on synthetic image: exact exception type/text/feedback and desired/floor masks, unchanged in off/B/C.
Actual bounded compiler retry handler with explicitly mocked planner/executor dependencies: three attempts and fixed anchor preferences unchanged under all six recorder faults.
Actual deterministic directed-interface planner filter with synthetic preflight and stubbed tool compilation: identical pre-plan RefineContractError with retained filter states.
B/C negative comparisons for input, contract, plan order, anchor order, allocation, mask, topology, exception and RNG differences.
Lossless detached view copies, explicit nonfinite values, no consumption of lazy iterators, no extra RNG creation/reseeding or CUDA access.
Truncated event logs, deleted/modified rasters, missing manifest entries and output-directory collisions rejected; event/storage caps invalidate evidence.
Rejection event counts kept separate from unique pixel sets and cross-guard intersections.

fault_injection.fault: JSON serializer raises, including explicitly encoded nonfinite values

capture_coverage: Source/case and joint preflight, ordered portfolio preferences and retry feedback.
Planner label/preflight/front filters, existing directional-limit inputs, interface ranking, capacities and selected plans.
Per-interface pre-ownership legal envelopes/protection/anchors, owner assignment, post-ownership legal masks and deletion budgets.
Requested allocations and realized contribution masks, desired/floor probe topology, combined change, original source/target binary regions and mutated per-grow source/target states.
Ordered passed guard stages, first rejection reason/coordinate, accepted coordinates and grow seed/seen/deferred rasters.
Already existing Python/NumPy RNG state at checkpoints and explicitly passed local generator state; CPU Torch state only when already loaded.
Structured exceptions and already-rendered compiler error strings; final qualification errors captured without changing the old failed-mask persistence flag.
remaining_evidence_limits: No real S07 execution or A-versus-historical / real B-versus-C equivalence has been demonstrated. The tests are synthetic CPU evidence, not new qualification.
AST equivalence and finite fault tests do not prove universal noninterference, unchanged timing, or resistance to OS process termination/resource pressure.
Only actual evaluated guard-stage outcomes are recorded; short-circuited conditions are not re-evaluated. Offline reconstruction must preserve not_evaluated/unavailable.

A dense fine-labelled failed target is not materialized by every failing business probe. Selected and before/after binary masks are captured; any later dense reconstruction must be labelled derived, not a saved historical target.

Ownership, legal-envelope unions/reachability summaries and unique guard sets can be derived offline from recorded arrays/events; they are not additional business guards and do not establish a causal area-loss decomposition.
CUDA RNG and inaccessible/unpassed local generator states remain explicitly unavailable. Observer does not create or discover generators to fill gaps.
The strict B/C comparator currently excludes no semantic fields. Any future necessary metadata exclusion must be frozen before execution; none was selected after observing real data.
Unsupported evidence types or recorder failures invalidate evidence out of band; they never silently become successful capture.
Old execution environment, full RNG states and internal plans remain unavailable; an unexplained A-versus-old mismatch must remain mismatch_hold.
before_any_P3: Independent review of observer implementation and this finite synthetic evidence.
Freeze full observer-build commit, input/case/contract identities, runtime/dependencies, comparison fields and storage reservation in a separate execution manifest.
Obtain separate explicit authorization for the already frozen maximum three-arm/six-witness replay.
Keep old results immutable; stop subsequent arms on mismatch/incomplete evidence/recorder fault/timeout; no retry, tuning or new qualification credit.
